description: Create a to-do (typically a 7-day commitment from a Delta Meeting). Put it on the person who will do it: pass their name as owner_name and OTP finds them (or owner_external_id from list_people). Never write a person's name into the title, e.g. "[Owen Cartier] ..."; the owner is a field, and a to-do filed under the wrong person lands on the wrong person's list. To share one to-do between several people, pass also_assign. Pass `repeat` to make it a repeating to-do: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or a custom cadence, advancing when each copy is done or on a fixed schedule, with an optional end. The response's todo is the first copy.

also_assign.description: More people who share this one to-do, by name. Each ticks off their own part.

due_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime; defaults to 7 days from now if omitted

meeting_id.description: Meeting in which this to-do was created

owner_entity_type.description: Worked out from the owner; only needed with an id OTP does not know.

owner_external_id.description: The owner's id from list_people. Only needed when two people share a name.

owner_name.description: Who owns it, by name ("Owen Cartier", or a first name only one person has). Enough on its own.

repeat.description: Make this a repeating to-do. Omit for a one-off.

days_of_week.description: Custom weekly only: which weekdays, e.g. ["mon","thu"]. Default the start date's weekday.

end_count.description: With ends=after_count: how many copies in total.

end_date.description: With ends=on_date: last possible date, YYYY-MM-DD.

ends.description: When the series stops. Default never.

every.description: Custom only: repeat every N units. Default 1.

frequency.description: How often. daily/weekly/monthly/yearly repeat on the start date's weekday or day of month; custom uses every + unit and the options below.

monthly_on.description: Custom monthly only: the start date's day number (the 15th), its weekday position (the third Tuesday; the last one if it is the final such weekday), or the last day of the month.

next_copy.description: when_done (default): one open copy at a time; finishing it creates the next. on_schedule: a new copy on every date whether or not the last one was done (an unfinished one stays overdue).

start_date.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`. Defaults to due_at's date, else today. The first copy is due on the first matching date on or after it.

time.description: Due time of day, HH:MM in `timezone`. Defaults to due_at's time, else 09:00.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the dates are in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to America/New_York.

when_done_due.description: when_done only. on_schedule (default): the next copy is due on the next date of the schedule (never one already past). from_completion: due one interval after the day it was finished.

team.description: The team it belongs to, by name or id (list_people lists teams). Defaults to the meeting's team when meeting_id is given. A to-do with a team shows on that team's view.

title.description: What needs to happen. No owner name in brackets.

name: add_todo
